password.directHelper: At least 6 characters. The old password stops working immediately; share the new one through a secure channel.
password.emailHint: The email carries a 6-digit code. The employee sets their own new password with it; you never see or handle the password. The old password keeps working until then.
password.modesFootnote: "Email setup link" lets the employee choose their own password. "Set new password" replaces the old one immediately.
